captions.detailed: A slim, light gray tower air purifier featuring a rectangular body with rounded vertical edges. At the top sits a dark gray rotary control ring, while a small black prismatic slider is mounted in a vertical slot on the side. The back features a hinged rectangular door that swings open to reveal a prismatic filter cartridge compartment.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a slim tower air purifier. The model must feature a main tower body with a top-mounted rotary ring, a side-mounted slider switch in a vertical slot, a hinged rear door, and an internal filter pack that slides out.
captions.factory: Construct the main tower body by extruding a rounded rectangle and cutting a hollow cavity, a rear opening, and a side slot. Create the filter door and hinge components using box and cylinder primitives, then attach them via a revolute joint. Model the filter pack as a series of thin boxes and mount it on a prismatic joint inside the cavity. Finally, build the top rotary ring using concentric cylinders (continuous joint) and the side slider using a small box (prismatic joint).
